root_resolution.energy_partition: 0 <= W <= (T-B)/2 for the slower outgoing electron; the other outgoing electron has kinetic energy T-B-W. This avoids double counting the indistinguishable electron pair.
root_resolution.model_interpretation: Fixed BEQ/general-Q BEB absolute total cross section with normalized conditional BED shape using the published rounded polynomial coefficients. This is a conditional hybrid closure, not exact reproduction of current NIST CGI outputs.
